name: Janna
title: The Storm's Fury

passive.name: Tailwind

description.normalized: Passively gain 5% Movement Speed. Nearby allied champions also gain this bonus.

passive.rawParsedText: Passively gain 5% Movement Speed. Nearby allied champions also gain this bonus.

q.name: Howling Gale

description.normalized: Charges up for 0.75 seconds and summons a powerful whirlwind that deals 50 / 90 / 130 / 170 (+50% AP) magic damage and knocks up enemies in its path. The whirlwind always reaches its destination in 0.5 seconds. This ability's charges are stored once every 14 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 charges.

w.name: Zephyr

description.normalized: Gains 10% / 15% / 20% / 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. The wind spirit automatically searches for the nearest 3 campions within range, granting Movement Speed bonuses to allies and dealing 50 / 90 / 130 / 170 (50% AP + 20% bonus MS) magic damage to enemies.

e.name: Eye Of The Storm

description.normalized: Blesses herself and the allied champion with the lowers Hp with a shield that absorbs 65 / 90 / 115 / 140 (+45% AP) damage and grants 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 (+10% AP) Attack Damage while it holds. Lasts for 3 seconds. If there is a turret within range, applies a shield to the turret as well.

r.name: Monsoon

description.normalized: Calls forth mighty winds of salvation to knock back surrounding enemies and restore 50 / 100 / 150 (+30% AP) Health to nearby allies each second for 3 seconds.
